# Module 3: Bias in Data Sets

## Overview

This module shows how bias gets into a data set. You will compare two samples and find the differences. The module takes about 3 hours.

**Learning objectives.** At the end of this module, you can:

- Identify three sources of sampling bias in a data set.
- Evaluate a data set against the course checklist (Module 2).

## Activity: Compare two samples

1. Open the two data files in the module folder.
2. Count the rows in each file. Write the two numbers in your notes.
3. Answer the questions in the worksheet before the live session on May 15.
